eventMetadata.context_description: Official forecasts from the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) for June 7 center on a daytime high of 30–32°C in Metro Manila amid the southwest monsoon’s onset, with 40–60% rain chances, partly to mostly cloudy skies, and isolated thunderstorms that typically cap peak heating through cloud cover and evaporative cooling. These conditions align with long-term June climatology showing average maxima near 32°C, while AccuWeather’s broader outlook places daily highs in the 29–35°C envelope. Trader emphasis on 31–32°C reflects this consensus, tempered by model uncertainty around convective timing and any brief clear spells that could allow brief excursions to 33–34°C. Updated PAGASA guidance and regional model runs in the next 24 hours will refine resolution thresholds.
